label_definition: absolute zero: (Y mm, T deg) state whose 5 pose values (QR536 mean dx, 4 screw dx) are 0 against center.bmp (rig_1st/center.bmp). Per-set zero = median of (vision pose - command) over the set. rig_grid (2026-11-12 forward) and rig_grid_rev (2026-11-13 reverse order): command + set zero + mean of the two sets' zero-removed (vision - command) at the same pose. rig_1st: L2 of experiment 20261113_0950. Sign follows the rig stage command (opposite to SEMES).
training_recipe: shared normalized Huber IRLS6, ridge1e-7, no augmentation. 5 values: QR NCC parabola mean dx + 4 screw gradient dx; bar tilts not used (weights 0, not measured), 2026-11-13. Previous model final00_huber7_qrncc_rig2day3638_avglabel_irls6_r1e-7
scope: rig_1st 280 + rig_grid 1679 + rig_grid_rev 1679 = 3638 photos fitted (experiment 20261113_1345). rig_grid_rev values were measured against the rev center and moved to this center.bmp reference with constants averaged over 18 center photos. Experiment asset, not a delivery model.
input_contract: single 3840x2160 uint8 image; no labels, date or filename in inference
known_limits: labels still come from image values (forward/reverse average leaves sigma T ~4.3 mdeg label noise); two days only; this module's fixed center.bmp rejects photos whose bars moved >11.5 px (as on 2026-11-13); closed-loop return not validated
